# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository-wide agent guidance in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for every task.

Before making changes, also read the project overview and relevant guidelines referenced by `AGENTS.md`.

Adopt the `discovery` agent role for session orchestration and planning. For coding tasks, follow
`.agents/guidelines/orchestration-guidelines.md` and coordinate the matching specialist agents rather
than implementing outside that workflow.
